title: WPMS/1310/2005 of SMT. GURMEET KAUR and ORS. Vs SHANKER LAL  and ORS.

paras.text:
WPMS No. 1310 of 2005
Honíble Alok Singh, J.
CLMA No. 6711 of 2008
CLMA No. 6712 of 2008
CLMA No. 6713 of 2008
 Mr. Bharat Tiwari, Advocate for the
petitioners/applicants.
 Respondent no. 1 has expired on
18.2.2008. Thereafter, petitioner has
moved an application for substitution of
LRs of respondent no. 1 being CLMA No.
6713 of 2008 along with application
seeking condonation of delay in moving
the substitution application being CLMA
No. 6711 of 2008, and another
application for setting aside the
abatement being CLMA No. 6712 of 2008.
 Vide order dated 15.9.2011,
petitioner was permitted to take fresh
steps to serve the proposed LRs of
respondent no. 1. As per the report dated
6.6.2012, proposed respondent No. 1/3
had already expired. Till day, petitioner
has not moved any application for
substitution of LRs of proposed
respondent no. 1/3. Therefore, writ
petition already stands abated.
 Consequently, all the applications
are dismissed.
 Writ petition also stands disposed
of as abated.
 CLMA No. 9735 of 2005 also
stands disposed of accordingly.
 (Alok Singh, J.)
 15.09.2015
Avneet/
